mechanism_narrative: A sustained period of FEDFUNDS at or below 0.2% signals an ultra-loose monetary policy environment that reduces equity discount rates and increases risk appetite, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE exceeding 9.0% indicates severe labor market distress that triggers equity sell-offs due to recessionary fears and reduced consumer spending, producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 40% of instances where UNRATE > 9.0% over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in INDPRO below 85 and PAYEMS below 131,000 signal a severe supply contraction that precedes inventory destocking and eventual recovery, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 50% of instances where both INDPRO < 85 and PAYEMS < 131000.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery regimes, FEDFUNDS at 0.15-0.20% with CPIAUCSL below 215.0 indicates stable inflation expectations that support equity valuation expansion, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS=0.15-0.20% and CPIAUCSL<215.0.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST above 580 thousand units signals strengthening housing market activity that correlates with rising consumer confidence and GDP growth, producing positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in > 50% of instances where HOUST > 580 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: GDPC1 below 16,000 billion dollars indicates deep recessionary GDP contraction that triggers policy responses and market bottoming, producing positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 45% of instances where GDPC1 < 16000 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO below 85 with FEDFUNDS at 0.15-0.20% indicates concurrent supply contraction and monetary easing, creating a catalyst for inventory cycle recovery that produces positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in > 55% of instances where INDPRO < 85 and FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.20.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in HOUST below 580 and UNRATE above 9.0% indicate housing market collapse and labor market distress that precedes policy intervention and recovery, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 45% of instances where HOUST < 580 and UNRATE > 9.0%.
